overview: Resonance Wastes are the most unstable zone in Mons Letalis.
details: Geomantic resonance pulses distort gravity, destabilize stone shelves, and spawn pulseborn anomalies. Even rockhoppers avoid the terrain.
hooks: A massive resonance pulse sweeps across the wastes.
Stone constructs malfunction and turn hostile.
A void fracture opens into deeper lunar strata.
A pulse storm reveals a hidden geomantic chamber.
